text:
olivia: Quick poll — team lunch today: La Banquise poutine (classic gravy + curds) vs Schwartz-style smoked meat sandwich? who wants which?
sam: Ooh both. If forced I'll take poutine. La Banquise lines can be long though. :thinking_face:
dan: Smoked meat for me — want something handheld. Any recs for the best place near the office?
jess: Schwartz is solid but a bit of a trek. For smoked meat closer, try Dunn's (on St-Catherine) — same owner, shorter line.
marco: I vote for trying the duck poutine at Chez Claudette — wild but worth it. Also they have veggie gravy option if anyone's skipping meat.
olivia: @sam @dan ok looks like poutine has early lead. who wants to meet at 12:15 and split lines?
sam: I can run to La Banquise and grab a few orders if someone chips in. ETA ~25min. :thumbsup:
dan: I'll take two smoked meat halves if someone can bring them — otherwise I'm happy with poutine.
jess: If @sam gets poutine, I'll take a vegetarian poutine (no bacon). Also can bring napkins/utensils from the kitchen.
marco: I can Venmo $10 to @sam for my order. food-bot: Reminder: team lunch budget limit is $15 per person for offsite orders.
olivia: Awesome — final count: 3 poutines (one veg), 2 smoked meat halves. @sam you're the hero. I'll DM order preferences.
sam: On it. leaving in 5. 
food-bot: Order logged: runner=sam, eta=12:40, amount_expected=~$55. Thank you! :pizza:
